#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <stdexcept>

class InputReader {
private:
    std::istream& stream;
    char buffer[1024];
    int ptr;
    int len;

public:
    InputReader(std::istream& s) : stream(s), ptr(0), len(0) {}

    int read() {
        if (len == -1) throw std::runtime_error("EOF");
        if (ptr >= len) {
            ptr = 0;
            stream.read(buffer, sizeof(buffer));
            len = stream.gcount();
            if (len <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[ptr++] & 0xFF;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (c != -1 && (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t')) c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int val = 0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        }
        return val * sign;
    }
};

class TaskG {
private:
    static const int MAX_N = 1 << 21;
    static double cs[MAX_N];
    static double sn[MAX_N];
    static double csi[MAX_N];
    static double sni[MAX_N];

    static void initConstants() {
        for (int len = 1; len <= MAX_N; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = len / 2; i < len; i++) {
                double angle = 2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len;
                cs[i] = cos(angle);
                sn[i] = sin(angle);
                csi[i] = cos(-angle);
                sni[i] = sin(-angle);
            }
        }
    }

    std::vector<int> multiplyPolynomial(const std::vector<int>& a, const std::vector<int>& b, int mod) {
        int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
        int n = std::max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(need - 1)));

        std::vector<double> aReal(n, 0.0), aImag(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            int x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            aReal[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            aImag[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        performFFT(aReal, aImag, false);

        std::vector<double> bReal(n, 0.0), bImag(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
            int x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            bReal[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            bImag[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        performFFT(bReal, bImag, false);

        std::vector<double> resReal1(n, 0.0), resImag1(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> resReal2(n, 0.0), resImag2(n, 0.0);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);

            double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) * 0.5;
            double a1i = (aImag[i] - aImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double a2r = (aImag[i] + aImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) * 0.5;

            double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) * 0.5;
            double b1i = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double b2r = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) * 0.5;

            resReal1[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
            resImag1[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
            resReal2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
            resImag2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
        }

        performFFT(resReal1, resImag1, true);
        performFFT(resReal2, resImag2, true);

        std::vector<int> result(need);
        for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
            long long aa = llround(resReal1[i]);
            long long bb = llround(resReal2[i]);
            long long cc = llround(resImag1[i]);
            result[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return result;
    }

    void performFFT(std::vector<double>& real, std::vector<double>& imag, bool inverse) {
        int n = real.size();
        if (n == 0) return;
        int shift = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_reverse(i) >> shift;
            if (i < j) {
                std::swap(real[i], real[j]);
                std::swap(imag[i], imag[j]);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            int step = MAX_N / len;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0, idx = 0; j < half; j++, idx += step) {
                    double wReal = inverse ? csi[half + j] : cs[half + j];
                    double wImag = inverse ? sni[half + j] : sn[half + j];

                    double uR = real[i + j];
                    double uI = imag[i + j];
                    double vR = real[i + j + half] * wReal - imag[i + j + half] * wImag;
                    double vI = real[i + j + half] * wImag + imag[i + j + half] * wReal;

                    real[i + j] = uR + vR;
                    imag[i + j] = uI + vI;
                    real[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                    imag[i + j + half] = uI - vI;
                }
            }
        }

        if (inverse) {
            double invN = 1.0 / n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                real[i] *= invN;
                imag[i] *= invN;
            }
        }
    }

public:
    TaskG() {
        static bool initialized = false;
        if (!initialized) {
            initConstants();
            initialized = true;
        }
    }

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, std::ostream& out) {
        const int MOD = 998244353;
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int k = in.nextInt();
        std::vector<int> v(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            v[in.nextInt()] = 1;
        }
        std::vector<int> ans = {1};
        int p = n / 2;
        while (true) {
            if (p & 1) {
                ans = multiplyPolynomial(ans, v, MOD);
            }
            p >>= 1;
            if (p == 0) break;
            v = multiplyPolynomial(v, v, MOD);
        }
        long long result = 0;
        for (int val : ans) {
            result = (result + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
        }
        out << result << std::endl;
    }
};

double TaskG::cs[MAX_N];
double TaskG::sn[MAX_N];
double TaskG::csi[MAX_N];
double TaskG::sni[MAX_N];

int main() {
    InputReader in(std::cin);
    std::cout.tie(nullptr);
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    TaskG solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, std::cout);
    return 0;
}
